headline_hi: एचएसबीसी विनिर्माण इंडेक्स: भारत की वृद्धि अक्टूबर में 54.7 पर धीमी हुई
summary: On 2 November, Pranjul Bhandari, Chief India Economist at HSBC, stated, "Strong international demand pushed growth of new export orders to a six-month high, supporting a robust rise in output".

headline_en: Voter roll cleanup: Amit Shah reports 3 crore infiltrators removed from lists
headline_hi: मतदाता सूची की सफाई: अमित शाह ने 3 करोड़ घुसपैठियों को सूची से हटाए जाने की जानकारी दी
summary: Over six crore entries in voter lists belonged to relocated voters, nearly three crore were deceased, and one crore were duplicate entries, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said.

headline_en: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram suspends all outdoor construction work for 15 days
headline_hi: गुरुग्राम नगर निगम ने 15 दिनों के लिए सभी बाहरी निर्माण कार्य को निलंबित किया
summary: The Gurugram administration will impose a ban on dust-generating construction and demolition activities in the district from 5 to 20 November 2026.

headline_en: BJP spokesperson CR Kesavan slams Rahul Gandhi for foreign help claims
headline_hi: भाजपा प्रवक्ता सी आर केशवन ने विदेशी मदद के दावों को लेकर राहुल गांधी की आलोचना की।
summary: On Tuesday, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi said, "You became PM because of foreign help. You remain PM because of foreign help.", and BJP national spokesperson C R Kesavan criticized him for his remarks regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi's tenure and foreign influence.

headline_en: HIV drug development: Dr. Reddy’s wins FDA nod for generic lenacapavir
headline_hi: एचआईवी ड्रग डेवलपमेंट: डॉ. रेड्डीज को जेनेरिक लेनाकापाविर के लिए यूएस एफडीए की मंजूरी मिली
summary: In 120 nations, the deal seeks to provide injectable lenacapavir for $40 per person annually.

headline_en: Wanderers Stadium final draws 7,900,944 ticket requests

summary: The Wanderers Stadium showdown on 21 November for the 2027 ODI World Cup final drew 7,900,944 applications for seats.
